hero.desc1: SafeSync brings the 7-domain health management framework proven by the WorkCare system to a mobile platform.
hero.desc2: From automated cerebrovascular & musculoskeletal risk assessment to legal follow-up documentation.

workcare7.title: 7 Health Management Domains — 20 Years Proven
workcare7.subtitle: The health management processes validated in the WorkCare system are brought to mobile and web by SafeSync.

basic.name: Basic Health Check
basic.desc: Measure and track BP, blood glucose, weight, and body fat. Auto-input via connected devices.

cerebro.name: Cerebrovascular Prevention
cerebro.desc: C-CDCI risk factor auto-assessment. Risk scoring and instant SafeLync connection for high-risk individuals.

musculo.name: Musculoskeletal Prevention
musculo.desc: Body-area risk mapping based on VAS pain scores. Auto-prioritized improvement plans.

mental.name: Psychological Counseling
mental.desc: HRV measurement and automated stress scales. Integrated trauma counseling history management.

lifestyle.name: Lifestyle Management
lifestyle.desc: Integrated management of smoking cessation, alcohol reduction, nutrition, and exercise counseling.

workenv.name: Work Environment
workenv.desc: Automated workplace environment surveys and hazard risk factor assessments by department.

followup.name: Follow-up & Statistics

algorithm.title: Automated Risk Assessment — Cerebrovascular & Musculoskeletal

cerebro.title: Cerebrovascular Risk (C-CDCI)

hero.desc3: SafeEntry covers all of the employer's legal responsibilities.

deadline.label: Reporting deadline
deadline.sub: Auto-reported to the Ministry of Labor

legal.intro1: Under the OSH Act Enforcement Rules revised in June 2024, the pre-assignment health check program has been strengthened.
legal.intro2: If requirements are not met, legal responsibility is imposed on the employer.

items.1: Workers engaged in duties subject to special health checks
items.2: Mandatory suitability evaluation for the planned assignment work
items.3: Health checks must be conducted before placement
items.4: Violations are subject to administrative penalties such as fines

items.1: For 7 special hazardous substances: results within 6 months
items.2: For the other 174 hazardous substances: results within 12 months
items.3: Recognized for the same or different work sites

items.1: Report within 30 days from the date the health check is conducted
items.2: Notify results to workers and the employer
items.3: Submit to the Minister of Employment and Labor (local offices)
items.4: From 2025.1.1, pre-assignment checks are also included

exemptionSummary.title: Summary of Exemption Periods by Hazard Factor

exemptionSummary.rightDesc1: Calculated based on the assignment date; recognized when a copy of the health check results is submitted.
exemptionSummary.rightDesc2: Includes pre-assignment, special, periodic, and temporary health checks.

items.1: Manual health check record management → risk of loss or errors
